Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps for Acme Commerce

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few asks so we can keep momentum: 

1) Key decision criteria you mentioned: latency targets (p95 < 250ms for customer-facing flows), multi-region failover, and SOC 2 / data residency assurances.
2) Procurement/procurement cadence: you said there is a standard procurement process and an SOW + PO cadence; can you confirm who owns procurement and approximate lead times?
3) Security review: would like to loop in your security lead for a short technical deep-dive on architecture, data flows, and compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report, ISMS).
4) Economic buyer: who signs off on spend (CFO/Head of Product/etc)?

As a next step — could you please: 
- Share a one-page org chart or list of stakeholders across Security, Procurement, and Finance (or attach the org chart)
- Introduce me to the security and procurement contacts on email so we can schedule the security deep-dive next week
- Flag any procurement docs we should prep (standard NDA/SOW template, vendor questionnaire)

I'll attach a quick mutual action plan template (MAP) to capture owners and timelines; if you want I can pre-fill a proposed plan based on today's notes. Proposed demo slots for the broader product overview: Tue Nov 24 10:00 AM PST or Wed Nov 25 2:00 PM PST. Please let me know what works.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the MAP. Great to meet you and the Redwood team. Per your asks: 

- Org chart: attaching our current org chart (Acme_OrgChart_v3.png) — note some recent changes in security leadership.
- Economic buyer: CFO Linda Park (linda.park@acme-commerce.com) will be the primary approver for vendor spend above pilot thresholds.
- Security: Omar Reyes (omar.reyes@acme-commerce.com) is Head of Security and will lead the technical/compliance review.
- Procurement: Sarah Liu (sarah.liu@acme-commerce.com) is our Procurement Manager and handles PO/SOW. Typical procurement lead time is ~3–4 weeks after legal review; we can fast-track pilots with a MSA + PO.

Decision criteria (high-level):
- Latency & p95 under load
- Predictable unit economics (cost per 1k tokens)
- Data residency and encryption at rest/in transit
- Ability to integrate with our existing infra (VPC peering and SSO)

Security artifacts we can share: SOC 2 report under NDA, network diagrams, and data flow descriptions. Omar will want a short list of sample prompts/payload sizes for sizing.

Demo availability: Nov 24 at 10:00 AM PST works for the product demo. Omar forwarded availability for a security deep-dive slot on Nov 25 between 11:00–12:00 PST.

I'll loop in Linda, Omar, and Sarah on the next email to make intros; attaching org chart here for reference.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Partnerships | Acme Commerce
alex.j@acme-commerce.com
(212) 555-0199
